identity.name: Hornback Bow
identity.summary: A recurved horn bow with broad ivory limb tips.
identity.description: Costs 2 stamina per activation. Deals 8 physical damage per affordable activation. Bypasses up to 1 enemy block per activation.
identity.lore: Made from the antlers of a beast that outgrew the forest.

effects.description: Costs 2 stamina per activation. Deals 8 physical damage per affordable activation. Bypasses up to 1 enemy block per activation.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
